notes: Searched original per-completed-operation hit counts, zero-inclusive histograms and rank-resolved input/output IDs. Bugy table is already documented and reports averages per nominal ore, not verified per-cast hit probability. Reddit 17n69p8 reports at least 20k rank-3 Serevite and fewer than 20 Khaz'gorite outputs but is approximate and lacks completed casts and independent rank-linked item IDs. Reddit zez5sj lists output quantities and explicitly cautions that gem percentages assume one gem per cast, which is not always true; existing cohort must be deduplicated. October 2022 beta milling guide cannot establish live drop distribution. No new independent verified numeric cohort; do not convert nominal ore to casts when Resourcefulness/refunds or reprocessing are unspecified.
